notes.title: 🎉 GoodMan is Officially Released! 🎮
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce that [b]GoodMan[/b] is now live and ready for you to play![/p][p][/p][p]Dive into an exciting world full of action, unique weapons, and custom levels designed to challenge and entertain.[/p][p][/p][p]Explore, fight, and customize your character with awesome skins as you take on the Badmans.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who supported us along the way. This release is just the beginning![/p][p][/p][p]Jump in now and experience GoodMan for yourself![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657766/021d5bd0f350aac31182d7eb21f36494d115df49.png"][/img][/p]
